text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer. Let's play it safe 
and take a short break here.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh? Where are we...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi!! The 60th Heart-Throbbing Pickup 
Line Showdown~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: !? A pick-up line showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! It's a contest 
between Golshi-san and Earth-san to see 
who can make hearts flutter with their 
wooing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So Golshi-chan takes the lead! Aw yeah, 
let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You know... You sprint full speed with a 
dried persimmon stuck to your forehead. 
Straight across the English Channel.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To someone like you, living recklessly 
like a naked mole-rat... Let me tell you 
one thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wanna be my "chazuke"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~!! Even the waves are trembling with 
excitement!! Doesn't this make your heart 
throb quite a bit?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So whoever shouts "Amore" is the 
winner.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then listen to this!! A passionate 
rhapsody—!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You always make my heart flutter, like a 
staccato to my soul.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure *non lo sai*. Yes... you haven't 
realized, have you? Just how much *amore* 
I hold for you."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Passion in your eyes... Appassionato...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And here comes the... crescendo! Shouting 
amore greedily at the center of the 
world!! La La La La La～～♪ (Chorus 
repeat)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-What!? When did this turn into a song!? 
But this one makes my heart flutter in a 
whole different festive way! It's 
impossible to choose between them!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Amore is infinite. There could 
never truly be a victor or loser, could 
there?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In that case... care to duel?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Let it echo across the entire world. 
Our concerto—

text_block_list.name: Earth & Golshi
text_block_list.text: A "Peace-Peace Amore Grand Ensemble"!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Still, 'Pisu Pisu'... I feel like I can 
make some great music out of this...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps spurred by a burst of 
inspiration, Sounds of Earth was able to 
regain his top form."
